mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT mobility signals a return of commuting routines that lifts weekday retail footfall, producing higher RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days despite continued increases in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT mobility.

mechanism_narrative: The strong rebound in PARKS mobility, reaching its highest point in the last four weeks, suggests improved public confidence in outdoor activities, which will spill over into other leisure activities, including retail and recreation, over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS increases by more than 5 points week-on-week and is above its 4-week average
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase in the next two weeks despite PARKS showing a strong week-on-week increase and remaining above its recent average.

mechanism_narrative: The combined effect of fewer people staying home (decreasing RESIDENTIAL) and more people moving through transit hubs (increasing TRANSIT) creates more opportunities for retail and recreation visits, leading to an increase in RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC decreases over the next 28 days even as RESIDENTIAL continues to fall and TRANSIT continues to rise.

mechanism_narrative: The consistent decline in RESIDENTIAL mobility, coupled with the recent uptick in RETAIL_REC itself, indicates a loosening of stay-at-home behaviors, likely driven by relaxed restrictions, which will continue to boost retail and recreation activity over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC declines over the next 28 days while RESIDENTIAL mobility continues to decrease, suggesting a different underlying cause.

mechanism_narrative: Despite recent minor fluctuations, RETAIL_REC has remained significantly below baseline for the past four weeks, indicating persistent caution or changed habits that will prevent a substantial recovery in the near term, leading to a continued depressed state over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days increases by more than 5 percentage points compared to the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: The recent significant increase in WORKPLACES mobility, surpassing the -20% baseline, suggests a critical mass of people returning to offices, which will directly increase demand for nearby retail and recreation options over the next week.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of increasing PARKS activity and decreasing RESIDENTIAL time indicates a general shift towards outdoor and public engagement, reducing home-bound behavior and increasing the likelihood of visits to retail and recreation venues over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC decreases over the next two weeks despite PARKS increasing and RESIDENTIAL decreasing.

mechanism_narrative: The consistent upward trend in TRANSIT mobility, reaching its highest point in the last four weeks, suggests a sustained easing of public health restrictions on movement, which will continue to facilitate and encourage retail and recreation visits over the next four weeks.
